name: detail
description: Detail is a typography component used for disclosing extra information or smaller items in hierarchical relationships of text.

emphasis.description: Emphasis of the text run: emphasized is italic, strong is bolder, and the two combine. Unset is the regular style.

family.description: Typeface family of the text run.

anatomy.name: container
anatomy.description: Root of the component: the block that holds the text run.

anatomy.name: text
anatomy.description: Text run styled by the typography token set.

anatomyReview.notes: No Figma component; the style exists only as text styles (Figma), a font macro value (React Spectrum) and one Typography stylesheet (SWC). Keep five components, one family. The text part holds the type style; margins are properties of it. The container part is a recipe-drawing root: the engine needs a box root and a root text part draws nothing, so the part owns only recipe alignment values; a spec change to allow a recipe-only root is tracked separately.
